note: MAIN CARRIES STALE GENERATED SURVEY ARTIFACTS, AND NOTHING SURFACES IT. Running make gate-full on a merge candidate, the heavy tier rewrote book/src/laboratory/generated/the-history/ and the-sounding/ with values numerically different from what is committed. It was not the campaign that found it: both files last changed in e9cb4a09 and 979508f8, and git merge-base --is-ancestor proves BOTH are ancestors of that campaign base, so the drift predates it. Why nothing catches this: the heavy tier is the ONLY writer of those two directories, make rebaseline does not regenerate them, and the everyday git diff --exit-code drift list therefore compares a file nothing has refreshed against a file nothing has refreshed. Both agree, and both can be wrong together. This is a live recurrence of PROC-red-gate-freezes-artifact, which names the general shape - an artifact whose only writer is a path the ordinary gate never runs. CONSEQUENCE FOR YOU: if you touch settlement or migration physics and see those two directories move under gate-full, do not assume it is your diff. Regenerate them, then ask whether the committed values were ever right. THE COMMAND THAT ESTABLISHED IT: git merge-base --is-ancestor e9cb4a09 44d7fb9f and the same for 979508f8, both exit 0.
